The Best in Veterinary Care
At Dogwood Veterinary Specialty and Emergency, we understand that pets are family, and they deserve care that reflects just how much they mean to you.
Our emergency animal hospital brings together
19 doctors
, including five full-time board-certified critical care specialists, board-certified services in Surgery, Internal Medicine, Oncology, Cardiology, Radiology, Behavior and Anesthesiology — all under one roof.
With a state-of-the-art facility, a collaborative team approach, and a deep commitment to education through Dogwood University, our team of emergency veterinarians offer innovative treatments to pet owners across Atlanta, Marietta, and the surrounding areas. Our staff delivers the highest standard of medical excellence with compassion at its core.
Dogwood combines technology, expertise, and heart to provide exceptional veterinary care — every patient, every time.
More About Dogwood
What We Do
Surgery and Anesthesia
Our
surgery and anesthesia
department stands as a beacon of specialized expertise, providing comprehensive care in both orthopedic and soft tissue surgeries.
Critical and Urgent Care
Our dedicated team of
critical care
specialists is committed to providing unparalleled, round-the-clock care for pets facing life-threatening conditions.
Internal Medicine
We understand that pets, like humans, can face complex internal health challenges. Our dedicated team of
internal medicine
specialists is here to unravel the mysteries of your pet’s health, providing advanced diagnostics and comprehensive care.
Oncology
At Dogwood Veterinary Specialty and Emergency, we understand that a cancer diagnosis for your pet can be a challenging and emotional experience. Luckily, the dedicated team of veterinary
oncologists
from our emergency animal hospital are available to guide you through every step of the journey with compassion.
All Services
Why Dogwood?
Surgical Expertise
Our highly skilled surgical team specializes in a range of procedures, including orthopedic and soft tissue surgeries.
Expert Diagnostics
Our team of emergency veterinarians utilize cutting-edge diagnostic tools to explore and understand your pet’s internal health.
State-of-the-Art Facility
Dogwood Veterinary Specialty and Emergency is at the forefront of veterinary medicine.
Compassionate Care
We understand a cancer diagnosis for your pet is challenging. Our veterinary oncology team is here to guide you every step of the way.

structured_data.name: Dogwood Veterinary Specialty and Emergency
structured_data.description: Dogwood Veterinary Specialty and Emergency is a 24/7 emergency veterinary hospital in Marietta, GA, serving pets and families throughout the Atlanta metro area. Dogwood provides emergency care, critical care, urgent care, surgery, anesthesia, internal medicine, behavior services, cardiology, oncology, palliative care, radiology, and specialty veterinary support.

location.name: Dogwood Veterinary Specialty and Emergency - Marietta

itemOffered.name: Emergency Veterinary Services
itemOffered.description: Most emergency clinics in the Atlanta area stabilize your pet and refer you elsewhere for surgery, advanced imaging, or specialist care. At Dogwood, that handoff doesn’t exist. We work as a team to take care of every patient, making sure each pet receives the best treatment option, with the goal of getting them home well as soon as possible.

itemOffered.name: Critical Care
itemOffered.description: Five board-certified criticalists oversee every Urgent Care, ER, and ICU case, supported by a highly skilled nursing team that brings the same level of expertise and compassion to every patient. When your pet is in our ICU, you’re not just being treated. You’re receiving world-class care from experts in critical care.

itemOffered.name: Urgent Care
itemOffered.description: When your pet is sick and your regular veterinarian can’t fit you in, urgent care fills the gap. Walk in any hour, any day. Our urgent care team is the same emergency-trained staff that runs our 24/7 ER, bringing critical care experience to every visit.

itemOffered.name: Surgery and Anesthesia
itemOffered.description: Specialty surgery for dogs and cats including soft tissue, orthopedic, and oncologic procedures. Built around the highest standards of anesthesia, monitoring, and recovery.

itemOffered.name: Internal Medicine
itemOffered.description: Dogwood’s internal medicine service is led by a board-certified veterinary internist and a board-eligible internal medicine doctor, with the experience and the diagnostic toolkit to reach a clear diagnosis in complex and chronic cases, and to manage that diagnosis for as long as your pet needs us.

itemOffered.name: Behavior Services
itemOffered.description: Dogwood’s veterinary behavior service provides comprehensive veterinary behavior care for dogs and cats experiencing emotional, mental, or behavioral challenges. Veterinary behavior medicine is similar to psychiatry and behavioral medicine in humans; addressing how the brain, body, learning history, and environment work together to influence behavior.

itemOffered.name: Cardiology
itemOffered.description: Dogwood’s cardiology service is led by a board-certified veterinary cardiologist (ACVIM Diplomate, Cardiology), with echocardiography, ECG, Holter monitoring, and the experience to evaluate murmurs, arrhythmias, congenital defects, and heart failure in dogs and cats.

itemOffered.name: Oncology
itemOffered.description: A cancer diagnosis isn’t the end. It’s the start of a plan. Atlanta’s veterinary oncology team for dogs and cats. Dogwood is the only clinic in the Atlanta area where every one of these emergency veterinary services lives under the same roof, on the same shared record, working together for your pet.

itemOffered.name: Palliative Care
itemOffered.serviceType: Veterinary Palliative Care and Pain Management
itemOffered.description: Pet palliative care focuses on comfort, pain relief, and quality of life while your pet is living with a chronic or life-limiting illness. Hospice care picks up where curative treatment leaves off, shifting the focus entirely to dignity and peace in the final stage of life. At Dogwood Veterinary Specialty and Emergency, we provide both - tailored to each pet, each family, and each stage of the journey.

itemOffered.name: Radiology
itemOffered.description: Dogwood Veterinary Specialty & Emergency offers Atlanta’s referral-only outpatient diagnostic ultrasound, performed by a board-certified veterinary radiologist (DACVR). We support referring veterinarians with advanced imaging, timely communication, and high-quality diagnostic interpretation - while keeping your pet’s primary veterinarian at the center of ongoing care.

subjectOf.name: Dogwood House Blood Bank
subjectOf.description: Donating blood is quite simple. It only takes about 30 minutes. When needed, a mild sedative can be used for the more anxious pets. Donors receive free complete blood work yearly, a small gift, and a lot of love.

subjectOf.name: Veterinarian Referrals
subjectOf.description: At Dogwood Veterinary Specialty and Emergency, we’re your trusted partners in providing comprehensive care for your patients. If you would like to refer one of your patients, contact our team to receive assistance.
